issue.title: [warmboot] swss crash due to translateVidToRid error for SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER_POOL

failure.body:
#### Description

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run test_warm_reboot
2. The test will fail with one OA core.
3. Check logs to see that it syncd initiated issue - translateVidToRid error on SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_BUFFER_POOL obj.

#### Describe the results you received:

```
Oct  1 <IPV6>.900718 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 ERR syncd#syncd: :- translateVidToRid: unable to get RID for VID oid:0x18000000000b35
Oct  1 <IPV6>.900894 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 ERR syncd#syncd: :- run: Runtime error: :- translateVidToRid: unable to get RID for VID oid:0x18000000000b35
Oct  1 <IPV6>.900918 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- sendShutdownRequest: sending switch_shutdown_request notification to OA for switch: oid:0x21000000000000
Oct  1 <IPV6>.901086 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- sendShutdownRequestAfterException: notification send successfully
```

…T_XOFF_ROOM_WATERMARK_BYTES on a pool where it is not supported (#1857)"

This reverts commit 3d6b1f023e6dbd95351e8739d427ca200b0b179b.

Fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8893

**What I did**
This commit had earlier caused issue on master image warmboot -
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8722

To fix this issue, this PR was created to retreat sonic-swss head on buildimage -
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/8732

Now, this commit was again pulled into sonic-buildimage as part of sonic-swss submodule advance:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/8839

And, warm-reboot again broke for the same reason.

This PR reverts the commit on sonic-swss, so that any other submodule update on buildimage will not fail warmboot again.
